I wrote the RPN calculator in `main.wj`. It compiles with `wj run --compiled` and gives the expected output on both examples from the task.

I also ran a few extra lines. `-7 2 /` gave `-3`, so division truncates toward zero. A bare `-` gave `error: underflow`, so it is read as an operator. A blank line was skipped.

I didn't test very large values near the 64-bit limits. The task says inputs neve
